original: caturthasyāhnaḥ - pra ta ajījanat prayadgāṣaḍṛcam | āśuṣṣaḍṛcam | babhruṣṣaḍṛcam | prasvā navarcam | hinvantīti bahiṣpavamānam | prasvānavarce āntyaṃ tṛcamuddharet | mādhyaṃdine pavasva dakṣeti gāyatrātharvaṇanidhanakāmādārasṛjaḥ | tavāhaṃ someti āśadaṃṣṭrottarārkapuṣpādyabārhadukthamāṇḍavābhīśavādyasvaḥpṛṣṭhāṅgirasāni |
analyzed: caturthasya ahnaḥ pra te ajījanat prayadgā ṣaḍṛcam āśuḥ ṣaḍṛcam babhruḥ ṣaḍṛcam prasvā nava ṛcam hinvanti iti bahiṣpavamānam prasvānavarce āntyam tṛcam uddharet mādhyaṃdine pavasva dakṣa iti gāyatra ātharvaṇa nidhana kāma ādāra sṛjaḥ tava aham soma iti āśa daṃṣṭra uttara arka puṣpādya bārhaduktha māṇḍava abhīśava ādya svaḥpṛṣṭha āṅgirasāni

original: punāna iti satrāsāhīyamantyam | sarve tṛcāḥ | ārbhave pari priyā divaḥ kaviriti gāyatraurṇīyavavṛhadbhāradvājanidhanamārgīyavāṇi | tvaṃ hyaṅga daivyasomaḥ punāna iti bṛhatkātīṣādīye | purojitīti nānadaiḍaśuddhāśudvīyākūpārāndhīgavāni | somaḥ pavata iti vātsapramantyam | sarve tṛcāḥ | anyat sarvaṃ caturthāhavat | sarvaṃ trayastriṃśam |
analyzed: punānaḥ iti satrāsāhīyam antyam sarve tṛcāḥ ārbhave pari priyā divaḥ kaviḥ iti gāyatra aurṇīyava vṛhat bhāradvāja nidhana mārgīyavāṇi tvam hi aṅga daivya somaḥ punānaḥ iti bṛhat kātīṣādīye purojitī iti nānada aiḍa śuddhāśudvīya ākūpāra āndhīgavāni somaḥ pavate iti vātsapram antyam sarve tṛcāḥ anyat sarvam caturtha ahavat sarvam trayastriṃśam

original: ṣoḍaśisāma ca ||
analyzed: ṣoḍaśi sāma ca

original: pañcamasyāhnaḥ - govidviśvaviddadhanviṣusaptarcam | prakaviḥ saptarcam | yavaṃyavacaturṛcam | ayāvītiapaghnanyāste dhāreti bahiṣpavamānam | mādhyaṃdine arṣā someti gāyatrayaṇvaśākalavārśāni | soma uṣveti mānavānūpavaiṣṇavādyayauktasrucavāmrāgnestriṇidhanāni | yatsomacitramiti śaiśavamantyam | sarve tṛcāḥ |
analyzed: pañcamasya ahnaḥ govid viśvavid dadhanviṣu saptarcam prakaviḥ saptarcam yavaṃyava caturṛcam somaḥ iti gāyatra yaṇva śākala vārśāni somaḥ yat soma citram iti śaiśavam antyam sarve tṛcāḥ

original: ārbhave asāvyaṃśuriti gāyatrasaṃtanyadhyardheḍaṃsomasāmagauṣūktāni | anyat sarvaṃ pañcamāhavat | sarvaṃ trayastriṃśam ||
analyzed: ārbhave asāvi aṃśuḥ iti anyat sarvam pañcama ahavat sarvam trayastriṃśam

original: ṣaṣṭhamahaḥ prakṛtivad ||
analyzed: ṣaṣṭham ahar prakṛtivat

original: ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ - dvāvaśāhavikalpāḥ

original: saptamasyāhnaḥ - prakāprasvānavarcam | asṛgrannavarcam | prayadgāṣaḍṛcam | yavaṃyavaṃ caturṛcam | ā te dakṣamiti bahiṣpavamānam | caturṛce'ntyāyā uddhāraḥ | mādhyaṃdine vṛṣā pavasveti gāyatrasantanyaiḍasauparṇarohitakūlīyagauṣūktaśākalāni | punānaḥ someti paurumadgakaṇvarathantaragauṅgavadvinidhanamāyāsyāni | pro āyāsīditi pravadbhārgavamantyam |
analyzed: saptamasya ahnaḥ prakā prasvāna varcam asṛj ranna varcam prayadgā ṣaḍṛcam yavam yavam caturṛcam ā te dakṣam iti bahiṣpavamānam caturṛcā intyāyāḥ uddhāraḥ mādhyaṃdine vṛṣā pavasva iti gāyatra santanya aiḍa sauparṇa rohita kūlīya gauṣūkta śākalāni punānaḥ soma iti pauru madga kaṇva rathantara gauṅgavat vinidhanam āyāsyāni pra u āyāsīt iti pravat bhārgavam antyam

original: sarve tṛcāḥ | ārbhave kārtayaśāduttaraṃ svāraṃtvāṣṭīsāmānidhanatvāṣṭrīsāmagautamāni āvapet | sarvaṃ trayastriṃśam ||
analyzed: sarve tṛcāḥ ārbhave kārtayaśāt uttaram āvapet sarvam trayastriṃśam

original: aṣṭamasyāhnaḥ - śiśum ete somābhīnavarcam | somaḥ punānonavarcam | somā asṛgrannavarcam | ayā pavasva dhārayeti bahiṣpavamānam | mādhyaṃdine adhvaryo adribhissutamiti gāyatravairūpāśubhārgavamārgīyavasaumitrasākamaśvavilambasauparṇāni | abhi someti dvihiṃkāravāmadevyagāyatrapārśvapauruhanmanāni | dhartā diva iti udvadbhārgavamantyam |
analyzed: aṣṭamasya ahnaḥ śiśum ete soma abhīna varcam somaḥ punāna ūna varcam somāḥ asṛgran avarcam ayā pavasva dhārayā iti bahiṣpavamānam mādhyaṃdine adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutam iti gāyatra vairūpa āśu bhārgava mārgīyava saumitra sākamaśva vilamba sauparṇāni abhi soma iti dvi hiṃkāra vāmadevya gāyatra pārśva pauruhanmanāni dhartā divaḥ iti udvat bhārgavam antyam

original: ārbhave pavasva deva āyuṣagiti gāyatrasvāśirāmarkagāyatrasāmāsitāni | abhi dyumnaṃ prāṇāśiśuriti aiṣiratraite | abhī no vājasātamamiti gaurīvitaiḍakautsaudalarayiṣṭhāni svāsu dharma | hinvantīti viśoviśīyamantyama | anyat sarvamaṣṭamāhavat | sarvaṃ trayastriṃśam ||
analyzed: ārbhave pavasva devaḥ āyuṣak iti gāyatra svāśirām arka gāyatra sāma asitāni abhi dyumnam prāṇa āśiśuḥ iti aiṣiḥ atra ete abhi naḥ vāja sātamam iti gaurīvita aiḍa kautsa audala rayiṣṭhāni svāsu dharma hinvanti iti viśoviśīyam antyam anyat sarvam aṣṭa māhavat sarvam trayastriṃśam

original: navamasyāhnaḥ - akrāna eṣa devo daśarcam | eṣa u ṣaḍṛcam | eṣa vājīṣaḍṛcam | eṣa kaviṣṣaḍṛcam | pavamānasya te kava iti bahiṣpavamānam | daśarce'ntyāyā uddhāraḥ | mādhyaṃdine pṛṣṭhasya pavamānasya jighnata iti gāyatrādārasṛgiḍānāṃsaṃkṣāraṛṣabhapavamānāḥ | parīto ṣīti pṛṣṭhaṃ tisṛṣu | kaulmalabarhiṣārkapuṣpādyadairghaśravasāni sāmatṛcaḥ |
analyzed: navamasya ahnaḥ akrānaḥ eṣa devaḥ daśarcam eṣaḥ u ṣaḍṛcam eṣa vājī ṣaḍṛcam eṣa kaviḥ ṣaḍṛcam pavamānasya te kave iti bahiṣpavamānam daśarca intyāyāḥ uddhāraḥ mādhyaṃdine pṛṣṭhasya pavamānasya jighnataḥ iti gāyatra ādāra sṛj iḍānām saṃkṣāra ṛṣabha pavamānāḥ pari itas si iti pṛṣṭham tisṛṣu kaulmala barhiṣa arka puṣpādya dairghaśravasāni sāmatṛcaḥ

original: devasthānasaṃskṛtivaiyaśvābhīśavottarāṇi tṛceṣu | asāvi someti dīrghatamaso'rko'ntyaḥ | sāmarājaṃ vā | sāmarājāntyapakṣe mādhyaṃdine pṛṣṭhasya sthāne pṛṣṭhadīrghatamaso'rkamāṇḍavāni sāmatṛcaḥ | ārbhave tva someti gāyatraṃ tisṛṣu | aśvasūktapratīcīneḍaṃkāśītahāviṣkṛtāni | tvaṃ hyaṅga daivyapavasva daivavītaya iti sauparṇavaiśvamanase ekarcayoḥ |
analyzed: devasthāna saṃskṛti vaiyaśva ābhīśava uttarāṇi tṛceṣu asāvi soma iti dīrghatamasā ūrkaḥ ūntyaḥ sāmarājam vā sāmarāja antya pakṣe mādhyaṃdine pṛṣṭhasya sthāne pṛṣṭha dīrghatamasā ūrka māṇḍavāni sāmatṛcaḥ ārbhave tvā soma iti gāyatram tisṛṣu aśvasūkta pratīcīna iḍaṃka aśītaha āviṣkṛtāni tvam hi aṅga daivī apavasva daiva vītaye iti sauparṇa vaiśvamanase ekarcayoḥ

original: pari tyamiti gaurīvitamekasyām | nihavayadvāhiṣṭhīyāsitādyasādhrāṇi | svāsu vidharma | upoṣviti śrudhyamantyam | anyat sarvaṃ navamāhavat | sarvaṃ trayastriṃśam ||
analyzed: pari tyam iti gaurīvitam ekasyām svāsu vidharmaḥ upa u su iti śrudhyam antyam anyat sarvam navama āhavat sarvam trayastriṃśam

original: daśamasyāhnaḥ - asṛkṣata pra vājinaḥ - pavamānasya viśvavitpavamāno ajījanad ete asṛgramindavaḥ pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ - somaḥ punāno navarcam | asya pratnānavarcam | iti bahiṣpavamānam | mādhyaṃdine uccā te gāyatrāmahīyavājigābhīkāni | punānaḥ someti rauravayaudhājayadairghaśravasotsedhayajñāyajñīyaniṣedhāḥ | ājāgraviriti gaurīvitamantyam |
analyzed: daśamasya ahnaḥ asṛkṣata pra vājinaḥ pavamānasya viśva vid pavamānaḥ ajījanat ete asṛgram indavaḥ pavasva indo vṛṣā sutaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ nava ṛcam asya pratnānava ṛcam iti bahiṣpavamānam mādhyaṃdine uccā te gāyatrāmahīya vājigābhīkāni punānaḥ soma iti raurava yaudhājaya dairghaśravasa utsedha yajñāyajñīya niṣedhāḥ ājāgraviḥ iti gaurīvitam antyam

original: sarve tṛcā | ārbhave svādiṣṭhayeti gāyatrasaṃhitakākṣīvatabhāsajarābodhīyāni | pavasvendramaccheti sapharohitakūlīye | paryūṣviti śyāvāśvāndhīgave | pari pra dhanveti sauhaviṣam | sṛryvatīṣu vājajidantyam | sarve tṛcāḥ | anyat sarvaṃ daśamāhavat | sarvaṃ trayastriṃśam | samānasā daśamadharmāḥ kāryāḥ ||||
analyzed: sarve tṛcāḥ ārbhave svādiṣṭhayā iti gāyatra saṃhita kākṣīvata bhāsa jarābodhīyāni pavasva indram acchā iti sapha rohitakūlīye pari ūṣu iti śyāvāśva andhīgave pari pra dhanva iti sauhaviṣam sṛryvatīṣu vājajit antyam sarve tṛcāḥ anyat sarvam daśamāhavat sarvam trayastriṃśam samānasāḥ daśama dharmāḥ kāryāḥ

original: [catvāriṃśastomadvādaśāhaḥ saptamaḥ]

analyzed: tena tejaskāmaḥ brahmavarcasa kāmaḥ vā

original: iti | yajetetyanuvartate | asya klṛptiḥ - aṅgirasāmayanacchandomadaśarātravat | stomānuguṇyenāvāpodvāpau kāryau |
analyzed: iti yajeta iti anuvartate asya klṛptiḥ aṅgiras sāmayana chandoma daśarātra vat stoma ānuguṇyena āvāpa udvāpau kāryau

original: tatra prathamasyāhnaḥ - asya pratnānavarcam | ete somā abhī navarcam | agna āyūṃṣipavamānasya te kava iti bahiṣpavamānam | mādhyaṃdine pra somāso vipaścita iti gāyatrāśvasomasāmāśubhārgavāṇi | pra soma devavītaya iti pajragauṅgavayaudhājayāni | svāsvauśanamantyam | ārbhave svādiṣṭhayeti gāyatrasaṃhite | pavasvendramaccheti saphākṣāre |
analyzed: tatra prathamasya ahnaḥ asya pratnānava ṛcam ete somāḥ abhi nava ṛcam agne āyūṃṣi pavamānasya te kave iti bahiṣpavamānam mādhyaṃdine pra somāsaḥ vipaścitaḥ iti gāyatra āśva somasāma āśu bhārgavāṇi pra soma deva vītaye iti pajragauṅgava yaudhājayāni svāsu auśanam antyam ārbhave svādiṣṭhayā iti gāyatra saṃhite pavasva indram acchā iti saphākṣāre

original: pra sunvāna iti gaurīvitagautamapadanidhanaśuddhāśuddhīyāni | kāvamantyam | sarve tṛcā | anyat sarvaṃ prathamāhavat | sarvaṃ caturviṃśam | aṅgirasāmayanacchandomadaśarātrasya prathamāhavadiyaṃ klṛptiḥ ||
analyzed: pra sunvānaḥ iti gaurīvita gautamapada nidhana śuddhāśuddhīyāni kāvamantyam sarve tṛcāḥ anyat sarvam prathama āhavat sarvam caturviṃśam aṅgirasāmayana chandoma daśarātrasya prathama āhavat iyam klṛptiḥ

original: dvitīyasyāhnaḥ - pavasva vācaḥ - pavasvendo vṛṣā somavṛṣāhyasy eṣa u ṣaḍṛcam | ayā pavasvapavamānasya te vayam iti bahiṣpavamānam | mādhyaṃdine vṛṣā pavasveti gāyatrayauktāśve | punānaḥ someti pṛṣṭhayaśaḥkaulmalabarhiṣaiḍamāyāsyatriṇidhanamāyāsyāni | vṛṣā śoṇa iti vāsiṣṭhamantyam | ārbhave yaste mada iti gāyatrahāviṣmate |
analyzed: dvitīyasya ahnaḥ pavasva vācaḥ pavasva indo vṛṣā soma vṛṣā ahi asi eṣaḥ u ṣaḍṛcam ayā pavasva a pavamānasya te vayam iti bahiṣpavamānam mādhyaṃdine vṛṣā pavasva iti gāyatra yaukta aśve punānaḥ soma iti pṛṣṭha yaśaḥ kaulmala barhiṣa aiḍa māyāsya triṇidhanam āyāsyāni vṛṣā śoṇaḥ iti vāsiṣṭham antyam ārbhave yaḥ te madaḥ iti gāyatra hāviṣmate

original: pavasvendramaccheti śaṅkusujñāne | ayaṃ pūṣeti gaurīvitabhargakrauñcottarāṇi | vṛṣā matīnāmiti yāmamantyam | sarve tṛcāḥ | anyat sarvaṃ dvitīyāhavat | sarvaṃ caturviṃśam ||
analyzed: pavasva indram acchā iti śaṅku sujñāne ayam pūṣā iti gaurīvita bharga krauñca uttarāṇi vṛṣā matīnām iti yāmam antyam sarve tṛcāḥ anyat sarvam dvitīya aha vat sarvam caturviṃśam

original: tṛtīyasyāhnaḥ - davi ete rājā tantvānṛpañcarcam | eṣa dhiyeti aṣṭarcam | iṣe pavasva dhārayeti bahiṣpavamānam | aṣṭarce'ntyāyā uddhāraḥ | mādhyaṃdine uccā ta iti gāyatrakṣullakavaiṣṭambhasaumitrāṇi | abhi someti paurumadgagautamāntarikṣāṣkāraṇidhanakāṇvāni | tisro vāca ityaṅgirasāṃsaṃkrośo'ntyaḥ | sarve tṛcāḥ |
analyzed: tṛtīyasya ahnaḥ davi ete rājā eṣa dhiyā iti aṣṭa ṛcam iṣe pavasva dhārayā iti bahiṣpavamānam aṣṭa ṛca intyāyāḥ uddhāraḥ mādhyaṃdine uccā te iti gāyatra kṣullaka vaiṣṭambha saumitrāṇi abhi soma iti paurumadga gautama āntarikṣāṣkāra nidhana kāṇvāni tisraḥ vācaḥ iti sarve tṛcāḥ

original: ārbhave tisro vāca iti gāyatrapāṣṭhauhe | āsotā - sakhāya iti vācaḥsāmaśaukte | sutāso meti gaurīvitaiḍatvāṣṭrīsāmatriṇidhanatvāṣṭrīsāmāni | pavitraṃ ta ityariṣṭamantyam | sarve tṛcāḥ | anyat sarvaṃ tutīyāhavat | sarvaṃ caturviṃśam ||
analyzed: ārbhave tisraḥ vācaḥ iti gāyatra pāṣṭhauhe āsotā sakhāyaḥ iti vācaḥsāma śaukte sutāsaḥ mā iti gaurīvita aiḍa tvāṣṭrīsāma triṇidhana tvāṣṭrīsāmāni pavitram te iti ariṣṭam antyam sarve tṛcāḥ anyat sarvam tutīyāhavat sarvam caturviṃśam

original: caturthasyāhnaḥ - pra ta ajījanatprayadgāṣaḍṛcam | āśuṣṣaḍṛcam | babhruṣṣaḍṛce ādyastṛcaḥ | hinvantīti bahiṣpavamānam | mādhyaṃdine pavasva dakṣeti gāyatrātharvaṇanidhanakāmāni | tavāhaṃ someti āṣṭādaṃṣṭrottarārkapuṣpābhīśavādyasvaḥpṛṣṭhāṅgirasāni | punānaḥ iti satrāsāhīyamantyam | sarve tṛcāḥ |
analyzed: caturthasya ahnaḥ pra te ajījanat prayadgā ṣaḍṛcam āśuḥ ṣaḍṛcam babhruḥ ṣaḍṛce ādyaḥ tṛcaḥ hinvanti iti bahiṣpavamānam mādhyaṃdine pavasva dakṣa iti gāyatra ātharvaṇa nidhana kāmāni tava aham soma iti āṣṭādaṃṣṭra uttara arka puṣpa abhīśava ādya svaḥpṛṣṭha āṅgirasāni punānaḥ iti satrāsāhīyam antyam sarve tṛcāḥ

original: ārbhave pari priyā divaḥ kaviriti gāyatraurṇāyavabṛhadbhāradvājāni | tvaṃ hyaṅga daivyasomaḥ punāna ūrmiṇeti bṛhatkātīṣādīye | purojitīti nānadāndhīgave | somaḥ pavata iti vātsapramantyam | sarve tṛcāḥ | anyat sarvaṃ caturthāhavat | sarvaṃ caturviṃśam | ṣoḍaśisāma ca ||
